Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert — elevated 429s observed for org TidalWorks in us-west-2. Root cause unknown, paging oncall.
Anna (oncall): ack. I'm looking into it now.
Eli (SRE): I can see a steady QPS increase starting ~20:02 UTC, roughly 5x baseline. Many requests hit org_quota_exceeded. Dash link: https://dash.internal/requests?org=TidalWorks (internal).
Anna (oncall): logs show repeated 429s with stack traces pointing to quota check. Org limit currently 500r/s.
Mike (eng-sre): tagging in. If customer impact is direct we can push a short override. Prefer to throttle noisy paths first if possible.
Anna (oncall): Support — what's the customer impact?
Jess (support): Customer reports intermittent failures and user-facing errors. They're seeing timeouts on page loads. I've asked them to pause any bulk jobs if we're able to give a short lift.
Anna (oncall): Proposed immediate mitigation: 1) issue temporary org rate bump to 2500r/s for 15 minutes; 2) enable per-org shedding on long-running completion routes; 3) monitor metrics and rollback if other customers degrade. Objections?
Eli (SRE): ok with temporary bump, as long as we have an automated expiry. I'll watch cross-org latency.
Anna (oncall): Applying override now.
Anna (oncall): ```bash
curl -X POST "https://internal.redwood/admin/quotas/orgs/TidalWorks/override" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ADMIN_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"temp_rate_limit":2500,"expires_in":900,"reason":"emergency spike - customer impact"}'
```
Ops Bot: Override accepted. id=ov-7f8c2. New org limit: 2500r/s. Expires in 15m.
Anna (oncall): Observability update: ~90s after override 429 rate dropped from ~18% -> ~1.2%. See quick snapshot: https://dash.internal/snap/ov-7f8c2
Eli (SRE): Confirming 429s reduced. There's a modest latency increase for other tenants (p50 up ~20ms). We'll keep an eye.
Mike (eng-sre): I'll open an incident ticket to investigate root cause; likely a retry storm or a misconfigured batch job on their end. Creating RG-4258.
Anna (oncall): Support — please notify the customer: 'We applied a temporary quota increase and are investigating the cause. We recommend pausing any heavy jobs until we confirm stability.'
Jess (support): Notified. Customer replied: 'Thanks — pausing nightly jobs and will share logs if we see repeat.'
Anna (oncall): Ops reminder: Override scheduled to expire at 2610009488 (15m from apply). Use /admin/overrides to extend or cancel.
Eli (SRE): Root cause hypothesis: missing exponential backoff in their batcher causing retry amplification. Ticket RG-4258 contains traces and recent request IDs.
Mike (eng-sre): Handoff: I'll be primary from 2610009200 for ongoing monitoring and rollback coordination.
Anna (oncall): Handoff acked — Mike primary. :handshake:
Mike (eng-sre): Monitoring now. If we stay stable for the next 10 minutes I'll coordinate a controlled rollback with the customer.
Jess (support): Customer requested an ETA for rollback — I told them we'll confirm within 10 minutes.
Anna (oncall): Quick ops note — to extend override manually:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://internal.redwood/admin/overrides/ov-7f8c2/extend" \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ADMIN_TOKEN}" \
 -d '{"additional_seconds":900,"reason":"still investigating"}'
```
Ops Bot: Reminder queued — override ov-7f8c2 expires at 2610009488.
Eli (SRE): Created follow-up playbook item: add 'temp-rl-bump + customer notify' to runbook.
Mike (eng-sre): Created postmortem placeholder and set severity SEV3. Will add timeline and root-cause once RG-4258 analysis complete.
Anna (oncall): Closing live thread here; continuing inside RG-4258 for post-incident work. If anything changes ping #incidents or re-alert. Thanks team.
PagerBot: Incident update: status moved to 'Mitigated' at 2610009288. Please fill out follow-up and link to RG-4258.
